name: AAA Particles 2.1.0 NeoForge
changelog:
- Mark Intel Macs as unsuppored so that this mod will not crash on them. - Turn of Effek GC by default and add a config option to re-enable it.

- (For developers) Add effek finalization metadata, that is used when an effek bound to an entity is despawned. - (For developers) API to set ParticleEmitterInfo's rotation from a forward vector. - (For developers) Add EffectRegistry#load/tryLoad to simplicify Optional Future stacks.

name: AAA Particles 2.0.0 NeoForge
changelog:
2.0.0 is out!
- This is a breaking change, mod made for 1.x is not compatible with 2.0.
- Add lazy loading & auto releasing for effeks, which makes memory footprint far more lower unless you've seen every effek in one game process.
- (For developers) Move some common useful implementation classes to API package.
- (For developers) Move maven group from `mod.chloeprime` to `cn.chloeprime`
- (For developers) Add an experimental vanilla particle proxy.
